newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers fully steady with last week's volume sales. Demand and seller interest good throughout the day. Confirmed - 56,500 Last Week - 15,600 Last Year - 33,200 Wk To Date- 67,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 74,000 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 50,100

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1325 lbs - 64.00-65.00, few loads Choice and Prime to 66.00; dressed basis mostly 104.00. some predominately Choice to 105.00, few early, and some in the far West to 103.00. ( weighted average 103.99) Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1225 lbs - 64.00-65.00; dressed basis mostly 104.00, some predominately Choice to 105.00, some early and in the far West to 103.00. ( weighted average 103.93)
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
